commit_subject: Collect Earth Cloud: map of progress for coordinators and reviewers: a Map tab draws every plot of the plot files at its latitude and longitude (the columns after the keys, as Collect Earth and PlotPlaceReader read them; another coordinate system puts none on the map and says so) by status: not started, started, submitted (the Progress tab's counts, plotUnits now keeps `started`), accepted and needs another look (the decisions kept), disagreement (the figures at hand only, QualityService.peek, never awaited); GET /map/plots (not /plots/geo, the page of a plot named "geo") gives compact [lat, lon, status, holder] arrays with their plot ids, 20,000 a page under one version, the counts per status, the files and the plots off the map; filters by plot file and, for coordinators, by person (plots they hold or assessed first), with the groups of people holding each plot; reviewers get no names and no person filter (Decision 3), collectors and project tokens 403. Leaflet 1.9.4 and leaflet.markercluster 1.5.3 at exact versions, bundled and loaded only on the Map tab, licence texts in web/public/third-party-licenses.txt; circle markers on a canvas, grouped from 5,000 plots a little at a time (100,000 plots placed 1.1 s after opening the tab in Chrome, no task over 260 ms); colours plus fill, outline, dashes and size, named in a legend table with counts and a switch per status; popups with the status, the people (coordinators) and a link to the plot's page. OpenStreetMap tiles with their attribution by default; MAP_TILE_URL, MAP_TILE_ATTRIBUTION, MAP_TILE_ATTRIBUTION_URL and MAP_TILE_MAX_ZOOM set another source (sent in server-info as mapTiles), DEPLOY.md says when and how; texts in 4 languages (Task 9)
